prompt: At dusk under a sky strewn with pink clouds, a bustling summer carnival unfolds along a grassy fairground. A towering Ferris wheel glows beside a rotating carousel draped in twinkling string lights, while rows of colorful game booths offer prizes behind bunting flags. A red-and-white ticket booth stands at the entrance, next to a popcorn machine dispensing fluffy kernels and a cotton candy vendor twirling fluffy pink confections. Nearby, a face-paint stand displays painted masks beside a row of juggling pins and a smiling clown balancing on a barrel. A balloon arch frames the funhouse mirror’s warped reflection, and a vendor cart laden with prize teddy bears sits beside a fortune teller tent where a magician performs card tricks for a small crowd. Across the midway, a tightrope walker crosses above a concession stand selling lemonade next to a pair of roller skates. Festival maps hang from a chalkboard, and wristbands rustle on eager wrists as a parade float rolls slowly past. There is no plastic chair, no food truck, no drone, no smartphone, and no modern billboard.
